_sources.discrepancies: NCSL classifies NJ as 'no document required' for ID. New Jersey has no-excuse vote-by-mail. Registration deadline is 21 days before the election per NJ law. NJ has online voter registration via the state portal. [2026-06-10] Primary date June 2, 2026 confirmed (FVAP; nj.gov): registration deadline May 12, early voting May 26-31, 2026. General Nov 3 confirmed: registration deadline Oct 13, early voting Oct 24 - Nov 1, 2026 (statutory nine-day window).

earlyVoting.notes: Early in-person voting for the June 2, 2026 primary ran May 26-31, 2026. Locations vary by county.
Nine days of early in-person voting before the general election: October 24 - November 1, 2026. Locations vary by county: https://www.nj.gov/state/elections/election-information-2026.shtml

New Jersey provides early in-person voting before each election (nine days before a general election: October 24 - November 1, 2026). Locations vary by county. No-excuse vote-by-mail is also available.

votingRules.phonesAtPollsDetail: New Jersey does not prohibit phones inside polling places. Voters may not photograph their ballot or other voters. Campaigning is prohibited within 100 feet of a polling place.
additionalRules: No-excuse vote-by-mail: all registered voters receive an absentee ballot application before each election; any voter may request and return a mail ballot.
Closed primary: only voters registered with a party may vote in that party's primary. Unaffiliated voters may not participate in partisan primaries.
New Jersey automatically mails a vote-by-mail application to all registered voters.

eligibility: Any registered voter may request a mail-in ballot without providing a reason (no-excuse vote-by-mail)
voteByMail.applicationDeadline: 7 days before the election (received by county clerk); in-person applications accepted until 3 p.m. the day before
voteByMail.returnDeadline: Must be received by the county board of elections by 8 p.m. on Election Day, or postmarked by Election Day and received within 7 days after
voteByMail.returnDeadlinePlain: Must arrive by poll closing on Election Day, or be postmarked by Election Day and received within 7 days after.

primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEn: New Jersey has a semi-closed primary (N.J. Stat. Ann. §19:5-1). Registered party members vote in their party's primary. Voters registered as unaffiliated may affiliate with a party at the polls on primary day to cast a partisan ballot.
primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEs: Nueva Jersey tiene una primaria semi-cerrada (N.J. Stat. Ann. §19:5-1). Los miembros registrados en un partido votan en la primaria de su partido. Los votantes registrados como sin afiliación pueden afiliarse a un partido en el lugar de votación el día de la primaria para emitir una boleta partidista.
